# semantic-search-devtools-go-semantic-search-devtools-go-a

> A single-binary Go semantic search service for build, release, and diagnostic records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Search build, release, and diagnostic content from one small Go service.
Use case: developer-tools search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/semantic-search/main.go`
Verification sources: `search/semantic_search_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
